content_sections.heading: CMFRI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. F.No.21-3/2025/NICRA-R/Vzm. gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CMFRI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.F.Sc.; M.Sc. in fisheries-related branches Experience: One year of experience in marine ornamental fish rearing evidenced by publications or CSIR/ICAR-NET Age limit: 21 to 45 years (on the date of the interview) Other conditions: Candidates should produce one valid ID proof at the time of the interview. Candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must submit recent community/caste certificates. Desirable: One year of experience in marine ornamental fish rearing evidenced by publications or CSIR/ICAR-NET

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on a contract basis for a maximum period of one year Extendable as per the ICAR guidelines

content_sections.heading: How Will CMFRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications based on qualifications and experience Shortlisting of candidates Interview Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by e-mail for the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in the prescribed format Scanned copies of original supporting documents from matriculation onwards Caste or claim certificate issued by the Tahsildar (if claiming reservation/age relaxation) Declaration in Annexure-I and Annexure-II duly signed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMFRI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the bio-data in the prescribed format. Send scanned copies of the original supporting documents along with bio-data via email to [email protected] on or before 18.11.2026 as a single PDF file. Attend the interview on 25.11.2026 if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All required documents must be compiled and submitted as a single PDF file. Candidates having marks issued in the form of CGPA/OGPA should produce an approved conversion table/formula.
